metadata.name: Zendesk Support
metadata.hero: How is your support team actually performing?
metadata.description: Answer Zendesk customer support questions using Fivetran-synced data via BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks. Analyzes ticket volume and trends, first response and resolution times (business + calendar), backlog aging, agent performance, SLA breach rates, CSAT/satisfaction scores, and channel/priority breakdowns using the fivetran/zendesk dbt package models (zendesk__ticket_enriched, zendesk__ticket_metrics, zendesk__ticket_field_history, zendesk__ticket_backlog, zendesk__ticket_summary, zendesk__sla_policies).

capabilities.name: Ticket Volume & Trends
capabilities.description: Tickets created vs solved over time, broken down by channel, priority, type, group, or brand

capabilities.name: Resolution Time
capabilities.description: First reply, first resolution, and full resolution time (both business and calendar hours) by priority, channel, and assignee

capabilities.name: Backlog Health
capabilities.description: Open ticket count and aging, by priority and assignee — surface tickets that have been unsolved beyond expected SLAs

capabilities.name: Agent Performance
capabilities.description: Per-agent ticket counts, resolution times, replies, handoffs, and satisfaction scores

capabilities.name: SLA Performance
capabilities.description: SLA breach rate and time-to-breach by metric (first_reply_time, next_reply_time, agent_work_time, requester_wait_time), business vs calendar hours

capabilities.name: Satisfaction (CSAT)
capabilities.description: Satisfaction score distribution, good-to-bad / bad-to-good transitions, scores by agent and channel

capabilities.name: Channel & Priority Mix
capabilities.description: Where tickets come from (channel) and how they distribute across priorities and types

capabilities.name: Reopens & Reassignments
capabilities.description: Tickets reopened, reassigned, or with high handoff counts — proxies for resolution quality

example_questions: What's our average first reply time over the last 30 days, business hours only?
Which tickets have been open longer than 7 days and are unassigned?
Who are our top 10 agents by ticket volume this quarter, and how do their resolution times compare?
What's our SLA breach rate this quarter, and which metric is driving most breaches?
How does CSAT distribute by channel?
How many tickets do we have in backlog right now, and what's the priority breakdown?
Which tickets were reopened more than twice in the last 90 days?
What's the trend of one-touch resolutions over the last 12 months?

quickstart_models.description: dbt models produced by the fivetran/zendesk package. The skill's resolution-time, backlog, agent-performance, and SLA analyses require at minimum zendesk__ticket_enriched and zendesk__ticket_metrics. SLA-specific queries require zendesk__sla_policies; backlog-over-time requires zendesk__ticket_field_history / zendesk__ticket_backlog.
